# Python Field Guide

> A free Python reference with runnable, in-browser code examples covering data types, collections, control flow, functions, classes, error handling, file I/O, style, and popular libraries. Built for beginners — every example uses the same recurring cast of snake species instead of generic placeholder values.

Code blocks throughout the site run live in the browser via Pyodide, so examples can be edited and executed in place, not just read.

## Core topics

- [Workspace](https://pythonfieldguide.com/workspace/): How to install Python, pick a code editor, and run your first .py file.
- [Foundations](https://pythonfieldguide.com/foundations/): Variables, print(), input(), and comments.
- [Types](https://pythonfieldguide.com/types/): Integers, floats, strings, booleans, and None, plus the operations each one supports.
- [Collections](https://pythonfieldguide.com/collections/): Lists, dictionaries, tuples, and sets, plus looping, filtering, and combining them.
- [Conditionals](https://pythonfieldguide.com/conditionals/): if/elif/else, match/case, and boolean logic.
- [Loops](https://pythonfieldguide.com/loops/): for and while loops, break/continue, range(), enumerate().
- [Functions](https://pythonfieldguide.com/functions/): Defining, calling, arguments, *args/**kwargs, scope, and recursion.
- [Classes](https://pythonfieldguide.com/oop/): Attributes, methods, and inheritance.
- [Modules](https://pythonfieldguide.com/modules/): Writing and importing your own modules.
- [Files](https://pythonfieldguide.com/files/): Opening, closing, reading, and writing files.
- [Style](https://pythonfieldguide.com/style/): Naming, formatting, docstrings, linters, and common beginner mistakes.
- [Errors](https://pythonfieldguide.com/errors/): Reading tracebacks, try/except, and debugging.

## Libraries

- [Libraries overview](https://pythonfieldguide.com/libraries/): Built-in and third-party libraries covered on this site.
- [csv](https://pythonfieldguide.com/libraries/csv/): csv.writer, csv.reader, and DictReader.
- [datetime](https://pythonfieldguide.com/libraries/datetime/): Creating dates, date arithmetic, and formatting.
- [json](https://pythonfieldguide.com/libraries/json/): json.load, json.dump, and nested data.
- [random](https://pythonfieldguide.com/libraries/random/): Random numbers and random selections.
- [Tkinter](https://pythonfieldguide.com/libraries/tkinter/): Widgets, layout managers, event handling, and ttk styling.
- [matplotlib](https://pythonfieldguide.com/libraries/matplotlib/): Line plots, bar charts, scatter plots, subplots, and saving figures.
- [NumPy](https://pythonfieldguide.com/libraries/numpy/): Arrays, vectorized math, aggregation, and boolean-mask filtering.
- [OpenCV](https://pythonfieldguide.com/libraries/opencv/): Reading images, color spaces, edge detection, contours, face detection.
- [pandas](https://pythonfieldguide.com/libraries/pandas/): Building a DataFrame, sorting rows, and summarizing columns.
- [Pillow](https://pythonfieldguide.com/libraries/pillow/): Resizing, cropping, drawing, filters, and format conversion.
- [requests](https://pythonfieldguide.com/libraries/requests/): Fetching data, checking status codes, parsing JSON, and handling errors.

- [About](https://pythonfieldguide.com/about/): Who built this site and why.
